page.overview:
Who is The Headless Horse?

The Headless Horse is a horse-like creature and the eponymous character of the ghost story The Legend of The Headless Horse. It is alluded to in the episodes Look Before You Sleep, Sleepless in Ponyville, and Scare Master and other media.__TOC__

The Headless Horse's build is similar to those of Princess Luna, Fleur de Lis, Princess Cadance, the Mane-iac, "Tropical Dream", Sassy Saddles, Mistmane's original form, "Peaceful Flower", Fire Flare, S06E20 Unnamed Earth Mare #8, S06E20 Unnamed Earth Mare #9, S06E20 Unnamed Earth Mare #10. Though its body is that of a mare, The Headless Horse is predominantly referred to with gender-neutral pronouns; however, it is referred to with a female pronoun in a piece of merchandise.

A different version of The Headless Horse was drawn by Andy Price between the winter prior to June 2012 and July 2012, being his first MLP drawing.

The Headless Horse was most likely inspired by the Headless Horseman made famous by Washington Irving in his short story The Legend of Sleepy Hollow.
